notes.title: Large Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

Redesigned main menu
Artistic changes across many of the levels
Updated project UE4 version from 4.19 to 4.22
New subtitle display system
Miscellaneous optimizations and bug fixes
Removed unused art assets to reduce build size


Biggest change that will affect everyone is the way the game is saved as the previous method was buggy and difficult to work with. Once you beat a level you can select it at will from the main menu.
